_sourceConvention: _source values prefixed `oca-` are OCA-jurisdiction (not flagged as gaps by the print report). Anything else is flagged unless listed in trackedGaps below.

parishOverrides.reason: Parish uses Holy Transfiguration Monastery (Boston) Beatitudes wording — 'sated', 'Kingdom of the Heavens' — not OCA-Hapgood. Documented in feedback_oca_audit_workflow.md (May 2026 audit).
parishOverrides.anticipatedRule: Future rule comparing Beatitudes text against OCA standard wording

parishOverrides.reason: Parish uses Slavonic full form before Trisagion ('Let us pray to the Lord' / 'O Lord, save the pious' / 'And hear us'), not OCA abbreviated. Documented in project_pre_trisagion.md.
parishOverrides.anticipatedRule: Future rule expecting OCA short-form pre-Trisagion

parishOverrides.reason: Parish uses standard Sunday Entrance Hymn ('Come, let us worship...') year-round; OCA Liturgikon prints Paschal entrance ('In the gatherings...') during the Paschal period. Documented in commit 0b5d18c.
parishOverrides.anticipatedRule: Future rule expecting Paschal Entrance during brightWeek/pentecostarion per OCA Liturgikon

parishOverrides.reason: Parish omits Litany of the Catechumens during the Paschal period; OCA Liturgikon includes it. Documented in commit 1504deb.
parishOverrides.anticipatedRule: Future rule expecting Catechumens Litany present in every Liturgy

parishOverrides.reason: Default Cherubic Hymn is Tchaikovsky setting (DGM paraphrase); L'vovsky preserved under cherubic-hymn-lvovsky. Future direction: make user-selectable. Documented in project_cherubic_settings.md.
parishOverrides.anticipatedRule: Future rule expecting a specific Cherubic Hymn setting per OCA reference

trackedGaps.scope: Eothinon Exapostilarion + Theotokion + Lauds doxastikon (11 eothinon sets)
trackedGaps.researchPointer: OCA Pentecostarion volume contains the eothinon set. No predictable OCA URL identified at oca.org. Investigate: OCA-published Pentecostarion (St. Tikhon's Seminary Press), oca.org service-music for eothinon-specific PDFs.

knownFailures.reason: Pascha is served via /api/paschal-matins (a fully distinct service); the regular /api/matins endpoint is intentionally unused. Audit rule shouldn't flag Sunday Matins skeleton against a date that doesn't use Sunday Matins. addedAt 2026-06-05.

Feast/saint Matins Gospel overrides the eothinon when a major feast or vigil-rank saint with their own gospel falls on Sunday — OCA rubrical practice. 01-11 Sunday after Theophany, 01-25 Sunday of Zacchaeus, 07-05 St Sergius/Athanasius, 08-16 Translation of Image Not Made by Hands, 11-08 Synaxis of the Archangels, 12-06 St Nicholas. addedAt 2026-06-05.

False positive: the Sunday of the Myrrhbearers Resurrection Beatitude reads 'beareth witness to you, O violators of the Law' — plural 'you' as object is grammatical in TT when the subject is plural ('violators'). Cf. 'I say unto you' in the Gospels. The rule's heuristic can't distinguish plural-you-object from YY drift. addedAt 2026-06-05.

Pre-existing: /api/liturgy renders a partial service on Lenten weekdays (Wed/Fri) when no Liturgy is appointed — Presanctified is served at /api/presanctified instead. Missing Epistle/Gospel is a downstream symptom; the underlying gap is that the Liturgy endpoint should return blocks=[] (or 404) on no-Liturgy days. Tracking here so L5 stays clean across the year. addedAt 2026-06-17.

Real builder gap surfaced by rule: on these polyeleos+ / Pentecostarion / festal Sundays the Post-Gospel Stichera section renders the framing verses (Through the prayers of the Apostles / Theotokos, Ps 50:1, Save O God Thy people) but no actual sticheron hymn. Sunday Matins post-Gospel sticheron builder isn't selecting the saint/feast doxastichon for these dates. Tracked here so M27 stays clean. addedAt 2026-06-18.

Annunciation Matins Aposticha is a Great Feast (Lord's feast) whose Aposticha structure renders a combined Glory+Now + single feast sticheron (no weekday-shape stichera blend). Real edge case, not a regression. addedAt 2026-06-18.

Real data/builder gap surfaced by rule: Sunday/festal Matins Lauds on these dates renders only the Glory-doxastichon + Theotokion (1 hymn) — the 8 resurrection stichera blend is missing. Likely a vigil/polyeleos saint where the Lauds builder fails to combine Octoechos resurrection stichera with Menaion. Worth fixing; tracked here so M19 stays clean. addedAt 2026-06-18.

Same root cause as M3 known-failures: festal-Sunday Matins Gospel + Prokeimenon override the Octoechos cycle when a major feast or vigil-rank saint with their own Gospel falls on Sunday. Sun after Theophany (01-11), Sun of Zacchaeus (01-25), Translation of Image (08-16), Synaxis of Archangels (11-08), St Nicholas (12-06). addedAt 2026-06-18.

Real bug surfaced by rule: on Sunday of the Cross (3rd Sunday of Lent) the Post-Communion Blessing hymn block renders the literal text 'typical' (placeholder name) instead of the resolved hymn. Either the Lenten variant path returns the substitution key as text, or the Cross Sunday cherub/post-comm overlay has an unresolved reference. Suppressed here so L16 reports clean across the year; underlying fix tracked as a content bug. addedAt 2026-06-17.

Feature gap (not regression): OCA Liturgikon prints paschal Entrance Hymn 'In the gathering places bless ye God the Lord, from the wellsprings of Israel…' from Pascha through Apodosis. The system currently renders this on Pascha day proper but reverts to standard 'Come, let us worship' for the rest of the cycle. L12 stays active so a future implementation flips these from suppressed to clean automatically, and so Pascha-day regressions still surface. addedAt 2026-06-17.
